lesson_title: Reception, Active Audiences and Aberrant Readings

items.title: Lesson Podcast
items.description: Audio guide to how social variables shape audience readings and produce aberrant interpretations.

items.title: Stuart Hall Reception Theory Explained! — The Media Insider
items.description: Explains preferred, negotiated and oppositional readings, with examples of aberrant readings — essential for this lesson.

items.title: The Audience Is Not Passive! — Sarath Krishnan
items.description: Argues for active audience theory — why the same text produces radically different readings across social groups.

items.description: Spike Lee's satire about race and television — a film whose disturbing imagery generates completely different readings depending on who is watching.

items.title: Manufacturing Consent (1992)
items.description: Chomsky on why different social groups read the same media texts with opposed conclusions — the mechanics of aberrant reading.
